Message from Principal
Dear Students,
Dear Students,It gives me immense pleasure to well come you to Dharmasala College. This
                noble institute of higher education is located in the western part of Assam enters the twenty nine
                years of its glorious journey. The college has fixed its goal to achieve high quality learning
                standards in the field of higher education. Dharmasala College was established in the year 1993
                under the tremendous demands of the public and co-operation of the guardians for sponsoring a
                degree college in the rural area and named after the dynamic village Dharmasala to cater higher
                education to the post Higher Secondary Students hailing from in and around Dharmasala. The
                College is located in the remote area of the Indo-Bangladesh border which is the most backward
                place of Assam since there was no college or institution for higher studies within the radius of 20
                kilometers. Moreover, the entire population of this backward area belongs to the below poverty
                line having no capacity to provide financial assistance to send their young children elsewhere for
                higher education.This College is situated at the heart of Dharmasala adjacent to Dharmasala
                Veterinary Hospital and the College is also very near to Gauripur Dev. Block, Dharmasala,
                Dharmasala Watch Post, Dharmasala PHC and Hadurhat Dharmasala H.S. School.
The College aims to facilitate the learning and holistic development of the students through a
                well planned curriculum and co-scholastic activities. On behalf of Dharmasala College it is my
                most pleasant duty to invite you to enroll in the College and march towards success.
Wishing a bright future of the college.
Dr. Mazibar Rahman Prodhani M.A, M.Phil, Ph.D
Principal,Dharmasala College
